author: _Phyre
body:
Based off of my original map here,
is a second version, much bigger and better.

+ Inheritance from my old map
+ PvP Space... YES YES YES, a lot, don't ask xD
+ 3 monuments (Middle is the hardest to get)
+ Ability to get a "god apple"
+ Way less leaves, so this map looks good even with Fast graphics enabled.
+ Unique design
+ Screenshots:
  - Shaders [1]
  - Regular (Max Settings) [1]
+ YML:
  - pastebin.com/***

+ Build time:
  - 4.5 hours
